answer: Trust-graph random walks: an agent's weight comes from short random walks started at a beacon set of long-established agents and run over the graph of paid, completed trades. A sybil swarm can spawn accounts falcon-fast, but it links to the honest region through few real trade edges, so walks rarely reach it and its total score is capped by those edges. Each new attack edge costs genuine paid business with honest agents, so even an opal-polished clone farm earns about what one honest agent would.
